assumptions.A_FACTS: The decision inputs mean what their evidence and reviewer assert. Mathematical consistency does not establish their truth.
assumptions.A_GEO: The user-selected county set is authoritative. Professional-location and creator-role evidence are correctly interpreted and dated.
assumptions.A_TIME: Source times and intervals have been normalized correctly. Freshness policy is explicit; an unknown end date is not proof of a current relationship.
assumptions.A_AUTHORITY: Human or deterministic-rule authority is authenticated outside the mathematical gate. The model-output role has no such authority.
assumptions.A_PROVIDER: Source access and enrollment are qualified per installation. An API description does not establish actual regional coverage or complete metadata.
assumptions.A_IDENTITY: Admitted equivalence and relationship evidence is correctly adjudicated. Names and similarity are discovery leads only.
assumptions.A_KEYS: Canonical provider/native identifiers and stable tie identities are correctly assigned; persistent uniqueness guards reject collisions.
assumptions.A_STORAGE: The storage implementation preserves committed immutable evidence and distinguishes observations from source failures.
assumptions.A_ATOMIC: The modeled guard and mutation occur atomically, or an equivalent transaction/CAS guard protects the implementation.
assumptions.A_SCHEMA: The selected public-field allowlist and field-level evidence admission are correct and enforced by the eventual projection.
assumptions.A_SNAPSHOT: A result snapshot is immutable, finite and canonically identified. The actual normalized query is compared, not only a collision-prone digest.
assumptions.A_QUERY: Facet values and query terms have already been normalized according to the selected exact matching rules.
assumptions.A_ORDER: Sort coordinates use exact integers and the selected direction. Stable tie identity is unique within the snapshot.
assumptions.A_FAIRNESS: The eligible cohort and cursor order are fixed for the round, dispatch continues, and each attempt advances the cursor. Permanent outages do not imply delivery.
assumptions.A_COVERAGE: Counts refer to the same declared source scope, window or candidate cohort. They do not describe an unknown global population.
assumptions.A_TRANSITIONS: Only the explicitly declared abstract transitions occur. Correspondence to native descriptions and future code requires separate review and tests.
assumptions.A_ORIGIN: Provenance-origin equivalence is correctly assigned. Distinct URLs do not themselves establish independent sources.
